bull_bear.body:
- Comprehensive healthcare ecosystem and logistics platform spanning hospitals, clinics, diagnostic labs, IVD companies, and pharma, with cold-chain and multimodal transport
- Well-established, repeat client relationships (~280 domestic customers repeat business in FY26, incl. 38 customers for 3+ continuous years)
- Promoter/director experience: Chairman & MD (12 yrs) and WTD & CFO (9 yrs) in logistics industry
- Widespread domestic reach across Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Delhi, Karnataka, Haryana, Telangana and Rajasthan
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- High customer concentration — Top 10 customers contributed 81.76% of FY26 revenue with no firm commitments; loss of a major customer would be material
- Dependence on diagnostic/healthcare sector volumes — Revenue is directly linked to diagnostic testing volumes and outsourcing strategies of healthcare providers; fixed-cost operating model amplifies impact of volume decline
- Rising supplier concentration — Top 10 suppliers rose from 22.70% of purchases (FY24) to 46.97% (FY26), increasing vendor dependency
- Integration risk from recent acquisitions — Three subsidiaries (Credent Healthcare, Credent Team, Alltrak Technologies) acquired within the past 12 months; synergy realization and integration are unproven
- Geographic revenue concentration — Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh together contributed ~56% of FY26 revenue
- FY26 KPIs are not like-for-like with FY25/FY24 — FY26 figures are consolidated (post-acquisition) while FY25/FY24 are standalone, inflating apparent growth and margin improvement
bull_bear.title: Bear — key risks

business.body: Credent Connect N Care provides integrated logistics, workforce, and technology-enabled support services to diagnostic laboratories, IVD companies, pharmaceutical companies, clinics, and other healthcare enterprises in India. Core offerings include home sample collection via trained phlebotomists, stationed phlebotomy/lab-technician deployment, temperature-controlled inter-state and intra-state sample logistics, corporate wellness programs (C3 Wellness), and a courier aggregation platform (C3 Post). It operates through 2 warehouses and 4 branch offices, with a fleet of 97 owned commercial vehicles and 2,589 riders as of June 30, 2026.
business.title: What they do

business.body:
- **Logistic Services:** inter-state and intra-state healthcare logistics, temperature-controlled/TAT-sensitive sample transportation, C3 Post smart courier aggregation platform (pan-India, COD reconciliation, cold-chain)
- **Operations & Supply Chain Management:** stationed phlebotomy teams at laboratories and hospitals, deployment of skilled laboratory technicians and paramedical staff
- **HealthCare Services:** home sample collection via trained phlebotomists, end-to-end phlebotomy services at client locations, C3 Wellness corporate health camps, vaccination programs, and diagnostic screening (ECG, PFT, digital X-ray, dental, ENT, doctor-on-arrival)
business.title: Products & brands

business.body:

business.title: Competitive strengths

outlook.body:
- Continue investing in technological capabilities via subsidiary Alltrak Technologies to build a proprietary healthcare-logistics tech platform, including pay-per-use models for smaller healthcare players
- Deepen client engagement by expanding into warehousing/distribution and healthcare-specific long-distance logistics
- Expand into Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities targeting regional, standalone and smaller healthcare providers via pay-per-order/variable-cost engagement models
- Explore strategic mergers and acquisitions within the healthcare ecosystem to expand service offerings and geographic coverage (no specific targets identified as of RHP date)
- Attract, develop and retain skilled employees through recruitment, development and retention investment
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: No physical plant capex; growth is via inorganic expansion (three subsidiary acquisitions — Credent Healthcare, Credent Team, Alltrak Technologies — within the past year) and organic geographic/service expansion into Tier 2/3 cities, warehousing & distribution, and long-distance healthcare logistics, alongside continued technology-platform investment through Alltrak Technologies.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- Consolidated FY26 revenue (₹21,416.18 lakhs) and margin expansion (EBITDA margin 13.29% vs 6.41% FY25 standalone) driven largely by consolidation of Credent Healthcare Private Limited
- Revenue mix shift toward higher-margin HealthCare Services (43.04% of FY26 consolidated revenue) alongside Logistic Services (25.26%) and Operations & Supply Chain Management (27.67%)
- Customer concentration easing (Top 10 customers down to 81.76% of revenue in FY26 from 87.92% in FY24) while supplier concentration has risen sharply (Top 10 suppliers up to 46.97% in FY26 from 22.70% in FY24)
- Geographic revenue concentration in Maharashtra (29.40%) and Uttar Pradesh (26.83%) for FY26

business_ops.seasonality: Revenue is seasonal, skewed to H2 (October-March) over H1 (April-September): FY26 42.09%/57.91%, FY25 38.18%/61.82%, FY24 40.07%/59.93% (H1/H2 split). Attributed to increased preventive health check-ups, corporate wellness programs, seasonal disease patterns, institutional client budget-utilization cycles and festive-season fluctuations in routine testing. Since employee compensation, vehicle expenses and administrative overheads are largely fixed, any H1 revenue shortfall or weaker-than-expected H2 growth can adversely affect profitability and cash flows.
business_ops.supply_chain_integration: Service-based company with no significant plant & machinery requirement and no specific raw-material requirement. Subsidiary Credent Healthcare Private Limited owns limited diagnostic equipment (Cardiovit CS 20 treadmill, Versana Balance V2 USG, LG Wireless X-Ray Detector) used in service delivery. Technology backward-integration via wholly owned subsidiary Alltrak Technologies Private Limited's 'LogiTrak' SaaS platform (real-time sample tracking, GPS rider tracking, workforce management, geo-fencing) used internally for own operations. No technical or financial collaboration agreements or joint ventures entered into with third parties.

verdict.our_read: Credent Connect N Care is a healthcare logistics and paramedical-workforce outsourcing provider (cold-chain sample transport, phlebotomy staffing, home sample collection) to diagnostic labs and hospitals, whose FY26 revenue nearly tripled to ₹21,416.18 lakhs largely on the consolidation of three subsidiaries acquired within the prior 16 months (Credent Healthcare, Credent Team, Alltrak Technologies), setting up the central tension of whether this growth is organic and sustainable versus a one-time consolidation effect, against a backdrop of promoter dilution from 87.52% to 63.66% and a Nil-cost 50:1 bonus issue just before the IPO.
post_listing_commitments: Promoters' Contribution of 36,62,000 Equity Shares (20.10% of post-Issue capital), held by Karan Sharma (18,31,000) and Tanveen (18,31,000) and allotted via the February 9, 2026 bonus issue, is locked in for 3 years from the date of allotment pursuant to the Issue

Net Proceeds utilization schedule: ₹2,680 lakhs to subsidiary Credent Healthcare's working capital (₹1,250 lakhs in FY2026-27, ₹1,430 lakhs in FY2027-28); ₹300 lakhs to Credent Healthcare's machinery capex (FY2026-27); ₹3,700 lakhs to the Company's own working capital (₹1,700 lakhs FY2026-27, ₹2,000 lakhs FY2027-28); ₹600 lakhs to repayment/prepayment of borrowings (FY2026-27); balance to general corporate purposes
